name: Feature request

title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''

---

## What problem does this solve?

Describe the gap or friction point this feature would address. Being specific about the use case helps us understand priority and scope.

> Example: "When managing a large catalog, I have no way to bulk-update product status, so I have to open each product individually — which takes a very long time."

## Proposed solution

How do you imagine this working? Describe the feature as concretely as you can — user flows, UI changes, API shape, config options, whatever is relevant.

## Why this approach?

What makes this solution better than alternatives? If you've considered other ways to solve the same problem, mention them and explain the trade-offs.

## Alternatives you've considered

Describe any other approaches or workarounds you've already tried or thought about.

## Additional context

Mockups, diagrams, links to similar features in other tools, or anything else that would help us understand the request.
